description: Na₅NpO₆ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NpO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-17°. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NpO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NpO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are four shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NpO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NpO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-17°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.54 Å. Np is bonded to six O atoms to form NpO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and edges with twelve NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.04 Å) Np-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Np atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Np octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Np atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Np octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°.
